name: UI assembles
source: rasya-taste-v2 R03 (UI assembly), for a section, not the hero
look: The product's own UI, live HTML in one window, builds once as its section comes on screen: the window rises 60px and settles, the side list slides in, the figures lift, the bars grow, the rows wipe in from the left and a notice comes last, about 2.3 s in all.

needs.words: the product's own UI as HTML in one window, with up to six groups of parts marked data-ua (side, card, bar, row, toast)
